# algizian_tenant (Resource)

A tenant: one sign-in domain with its own users, OIDC clients, providers and branding. With an organization (`org` or the provider default) the name `<slug>.algizian.com` is assigned and returned in `slug`; only a platform token may choose a slug. Deleting a tenant needs a platform token or an organization admin token; set `locked = true` to protect it. The logo is uploaded through the logo endpoint and is not managed by this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "algizian_tenant" "myapp" {
  name      = "MyApp"
  providers = ["google", "microsoft", "apple"]

  # Production tenants are locked: neither the API nor `terraform destroy` deletes them.
  # Set this to false and apply first to retire one. Temporary test tenants leave it off.
  locked = true

  branding = {
    display_name  = "MyApp"
    primary_color = "#1f6feb"
    sign_in_title = "Sign in to MyApp"
  }

  tags = {
    product = "myapp"
    env     = "prod"
  }
}

# A temporary tenant for a test run: no lock, so `terraform destroy` removes it.
resource "algizian_tenant" "scratch" {
  name = "Scratch test"
  tags = { purpose = "ci" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `branding` (Attributes) Sign-in page branding. An attribute removed from the configuration is cleared. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--branding))
- `locked` (Boolean) Deletion lock. While `true` the API refuses to delete the tenant (and so does `terraform destroy`); set it to `false` and apply before destroying. Leave it off for temporary test tenants. Default `false`.
- `name` (String) Display name of the tenant (1 to 80 characters). Defaults to the branding display name, else the slug.
- `org` (String) Organization slug. Defaults to the provider `org`. A tenant cannot move between organizations.
- `providers` (Set of String) Sign-in providers offered: `google`, `microsoft`, `apple`, `email`. Default: all of them. See the `algizian_providers` data source.
- `slug` (String) The tenant name in `<slug>.algizian.com` (4 to 40 characters). Assigned when the tenant is created under an organization; set it only with a platform token. Cannot be changed.
- `tags` (Map of String) Free labels (at most 20; keys start with a letter and use `a-z 0-9 . _ : -`, values up to 256 characters). Algizian never reads them. The map replaces the object's tags as a whole; set `{}` to clear them.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The slug.
- `issuer` (String) The default issuer `https://<slug>.algizian.com`. With an active custom domain the issuer is the custom host, see `algizian_custom_domain`.

<a id="nestedatt--branding"></a>
### Nested Schema for `branding`

Optional:

- `background_color` (String) Page background, `#rrggbb`.
- `consent_note` (String) Note on the consent screen (up to 300 characters).
- `display_name` (String) Name shown on the sign-in page and in consent screens (1 to 80 characters).
- `footer_text` (String) Footer line (up to 200 characters).
- `primary_color` (String) Button colour, `#rrggbb`.
- `shared_app_notice` (String) Notice shown while the shared provider app is used (up to 300 characters).
- `sign_in_subtitle` (String) Text under the heading (up to 200 characters).
- `sign_in_title` (String) Heading of the sign-in page (up to 80 characters).
- `text_color` (String) Text colour, `#rrggbb`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import algizian_tenant.myapp k3x9q2a
```
